svg.title: From 6 billion users to 5,000 frontier users
svg.desc: A four-band funnel with widths sized by log10 of each value: 6 billion-plus users have maybe touched an LLM; 1 to 2 billion are casual free-tier users; about 20 million are professionals taking weeks-long work down to days; about 5,000 frontier users run thousands of agents. The span is six orders of magnitude, so band widths follow a log10 scale. The funnel was cited from a weekend tweet, relayed in the Arize AI talk.
svg.text: From 6 billion users to 5,000 frontier users
A weekend tweet framed the gap between touching an LLM and running swarms of agents.
taking weeks-long work down to days
Band width by log10 scale — the span is six orders of magnitude.
Funnel cited in the talk from a weekend tweet by “Kripati” (as transcribed in the record).
Source: Aparna Dhinakaran (Arize AI), “What does an AI engineer do?”, AI Engineer NYC 2026, day 1.
